summary.en: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are in a townhouse cafe, when later, the manager Satoshi Tomita is found unconscious on the floor. Location: "Sweets" cafe Victim: Satoshi Tomita Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Chitose Sakai, Kenji Nonaka, and Yoshihisa Furukawa When Nonaka enters the bathroom, he discovers the manager lying on the floor after being struck in the head. The suspects are a part-time worker, a cafe owner in the neighborhood and a customer. The police suspects Nonaka because he didn't have an alibi, but Conan, with help of some clues, discovers the real culprit.
